name: code-ontology-companion
description: Map Java/Spring or Python code structure, dependencies, and change impact into an auditable local knowledge graph without running the repository.

interface.shortDescription: Map code structure and change impact
interface.longDescription: Map an authorized Java, Spring, or Python repository into immutable local knowledge-graph snapshots. Answer source-level questions such as where a Spring bean is injected, what may be statically affected by a change, and how two snapshots differ. Every relationship retains a stable extraction rule, qualitative evidence basis, repository-relative source span, and explicit runtime limitation. Search through read-only local MCP, export RDF 1.1 Turtle, preserve provenance, and explore the same bounded neighborhood in an accessible offline 2D view or optional 3D constellation. Deterministic analysis and MCP do not execute or change target code, browse the web, send telemetry, or make network requests. They do not provide runtime traces or causal proof. Separately authorized bounded-loopback Ollama suggestions remain inferred and outside the observed graph.
defaultPrompt: Map this authorized Spring project so I can see its structure, bean injection, and static dependencies.
If I change OrderService, what code may be affected? Show static evidence and runtime limitations.
Compare my current and previous ontology snapshots and explain what structurally changed.
